# ============================================================
# LOAD DATA 
# ============================================================
```{r load_data}
set.seed(123)

counts  <- read.csv("Merged_Count.csv", row.names = 1, header = TRUE, check.names = FALSE)
coldata <- read.csv("ColData.csv", row.names = 1)
common  <- intersect(colnames(counts), rownames(coldata))
counts  <- counts[, common, drop = FALSE]
coldata <- coldata[common, , drop = FALSE]

# DESeqDataSet — filtered
dds0 <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = counts, colData = coldata, design = ~ 1)
dds0 <- dds0[rowSums(counts(dds0) >= 5) >= 3, ]

# Save background miRNA list for DIANA
miRNA_for_background <- rownames(dds0)
write.table(miRNA_for_background, file = "DIANA_background_miRNAs.txt",
            quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE, col.names = FALSE)

# VST for PCA and expression plots
vsd <- varianceStabilizingTransformation(dds0, blind = TRUE)
mat <- assay(vsd)
```

## Figure 5B — Raw vs Normalized Library Sizes
```{r fig5B}
dds_sf <- estimateSizeFactors(dds0)

lib_df <- bind_rows(
  tibble(Sample = colnames(dds0),
         Counts = colSums(counts(dds_sf, normalized = FALSE)),
         Type   = "Raw"),
  tibble(Sample = colnames(dds0),
         Counts = colSums(counts(dds_sf, normalized = TRUE)),
         Type   = "Normalized")
)

fig5B <- ggplot(lib_df, aes(x = Sample, y = Counts, fill = Type)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge", width = 0.7) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Raw" = "#7EC8E3", "Normalized" = "#90EE90"),
                    name = NULL) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::scientific) +
  labs(x = "Sample ID", y = "Total counts") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x  = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 11),
    axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 11),
    axis.title   = element_text(size = 13),
    legend.text  = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.position = "top"
  )

ggsave("Figure_5B.tiff", plot = fig5B,
       width = 7, height = 5, dpi = 300, compression = "lzw")
```

## Figure 5C — PCA Plot (PC1 vs PC2, labeled by Sample ID)
```{r fig5C}
rv        <- rowVars(mat)
top_genes <- order(rv, decreasing = TRUE)[seq_len(min(500, length(rv)))]
pc        <- prcomp(t(mat[top_genes, ]), center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)
percentVar <- 100 * (pc$sdev^2) / sum(pc$sdev^2)

scores <- as.data.frame(pc$x) %>%
  rownames_to_column("Sample") %>%
  left_join(rownames_to_column(as.data.frame(coldata), var = "Sample"), by = "Sample")

# Save outputs
write.csv(tibble(PC = paste0("PC", seq_along(percentVar)),
                 PercentVariance = percentVar),
          "PCA_percent_variance.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(scores, "PCA_sample_scores.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(as.data.frame(pc$rotation) %>% rownames_to_column("Feature"),
          "PCA_feature_loadings_topGenes.csv", row.names = FALSE)

fig5C <- ggplot(scores, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = Sample, label = Sample)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(size = 3.5, show.legend = FALSE) +
  labs(
    x = paste0("PC1 (", round(percentVar[1], 1), "% variance)"),
    y = paste0("PC2 (", round(percentVar[2], 1), "% variance)")
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.text  = element_text(size = 11),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 13)
  )

# Install ggrepel if needed: install.packages("ggrepel")
ggsave("Figure_5C.tiff", plot = fig5C,
       width = 6, height = 5, dpi = 300, compression = "lzw")
```

# ============================================================
# FIGURE 6 — Regression Analysis: PC2 vs SED60+ (4-panel)
# Generated fully in R using patchwork
# ============================================================
```{r fig6}
# ---- Helper: correlation annotation ----
make_label <- function(x, y) {
  complete_idx <- complete.cases(x, y)
  x <- x[complete_idx]; y <- y[complete_idx]
  p  <- cor.test(x, y, method = "pearson")
  sp <- cor.test(x, y, method = "spearman", exact = FALSE)
  sprintf(
    "r = %.3f , p-value = %.3f\n\u03c1 = %.3f , p-value = %.3f",
    p$estimate, p$p.value,
    sp$estimate, sp$p.value
  )
}

# ---- Helper: single panel ----
make_panel <- function(x_var, y_var, quartile_var, title, panel_label) {
  df <- data.frame(x = x_var, y = y_var, Quartile = quartile_var) %>%
    filter(!is.na(x) & !is.na(y) & !is.na(Quartile))

  df$Quartile <- factor(df$Quartile,
    levels = c(
      unique(df$Quartile[grepl("Lower",   df$Quartile, ignore.case = TRUE)]),
      unique(df$Quartile[grepl("Inter",   df$Quartile, ignore.case = TRUE)]),
      unique(df$Quartile[grepl("Greater", df$Quartile, ignore.case = TRUE)])
    )
  )

  ggplot(df, aes(x = x, y = y, color = Quartile)) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "black", se = TRUE,
                fill = "grey80", linewidth = 0.9) +
    geom_point(size = 3) +
    annotate("label", x = Inf, y = -Inf,
             label = make_label(df$x, df$y),
             hjust = 1.05, vjust = -0.2,
             size = 4.0, label.size = 0.4, family = "sans") +
    scale_color_manual(
      name   = NULL,
      values = c("red", "darkgreen", "royalblue"),
      labels = c("Q1", "Interquartile Range", "Q3")
    ) +
    labs(
      title = title,
      x     = "Average minutes/day in sedentary bouts greater than or equal to 60 minutes",
      y     = "PC2"
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      plot.title   = element_text(size = 13, hjust = 0.5),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 11),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 13),
      axis.text    = element_text(size = 11),
      legend.text  = element_text(size = 12),
      plot.tag     = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15)
    ) +
    labs(tag = panel_label)
}

# Attach sedentary data to scores
plot_df <- scores %>%
  mutate(
    T1_sed = coldata$sed60num_trimester1,
    T2_sed = coldata$sed60num_trimester2,
    T3_sed = coldata$sed60num_trimester3,
    PP_sed = coldata$sed60num_postpartum,
    T1_qrt = coldata$sed60num_quartile_trimester1,
    T2_qrt = coldata$sed60num_quartile_trimester2,
    T3_qrt = coldata$sed60num_quartile_trimester3,
    PP_qrt = coldata$sed60num_quartile_postpartum
  )

pA <- make_panel(plot_df$T1_sed, plot_df$PC2, plot_df$T1_qrt,
  "Regression Analysis PC2: Trimester One Prolonged\nSedentary Behavior", "A")
pB <- make_panel(plot_df$T2_sed, plot_df$PC2, plot_df$T2_qrt,
  "Regression Analysis PC2: Trimester Two Prolonged\nSedentary Behavior", "B")
pC <- make_panel(plot_df$T3_sed, plot_df$PC2, plot_df$T3_qrt,
  "Regression Analysis PC2: Trimester Three Prolonged\nSedentary Behavior", "C")
pD <- make_panel(plot_df$PP_sed, plot_df$PC2, plot_df$PP_qrt,
  "Regression Analysis PC2: Postpartum Prolonged Sedentary Behavior", "D")

fig6 <- (pA + pB + pC + pD) +
  plot_layout(ncol = 2, guides = "collect") &
  theme(legend.position = "top")

ggsave("Figure_6_Maternal_Activity_ISEV.tiff", plot = fig6,
       width = 12, height = 10, dpi = 300, compression = "lzw")
```

# ============================================================
# miRNA DIFFERENTIAL EXPRESSION — DESeq2
# Sedentary behavior (SED60+) and MVPA, all timepoints
# ============================================================
```{r deseq2}
run_deseq <- function(coldata, counts, group_col, ref_level, contrast_levels,
                      output_file) {
  coldata_filt <- coldata %>%
    dplyr::select(all_of(group_col)) %>%
    filter(.data[[group_col]] != "Interquartile range") %>%
    mutate(Group = ifelse(grepl("Lower", .data[[group_col]]), "Low", "High")) %>%
    dplyr::select(Group)

  coldata_filt$Group <- factor(coldata_filt$Group, levels = c("Low", "High"))
  counts_filt        <- counts[, rownames(coldata_filt)]

  dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = counts_filt,
                                colData   = coldata_filt,
                                design    = ~ Group)
  dds <- estimateSizeFactors(dds)
  dds <- dds[rowSums(counts(dds, normalized = TRUE) >= 5) >= 3, ]
  dds$Group <- relevel(dds$Group, ref = ref_level)
  dds <- DESeq(dds)

  res <- results(dds, contrast = contrast_levels)
  degs <- na.omit(res[which(res$padj < 0.10), ])
  write.csv(as.data.frame(degs), output_file)
  return(res)
}

# ---- Sedentary behavior (SED60+) ----
results_activity_T1 <- run_deseq(coldata, counts,
  "sed60num_quartile_trimester1", "High", c("Group", "Low", "High"),
  "results_activity_T1_DEGs_NAomit.csv")

results_activity_T2 <- run_deseq(coldata, counts,
  "sed60num_quartile_trimester2", "High", c("Group", "Low", "High"),
  "results_activity_T2_DEGs_NAomit.csv")

results_activity_T3 <- run_deseq(coldata, counts,
  "sed60num_quartile_trimester3", "High", c("Group", "Low", "High"),
  "results_activity_T3_DEGs_NAomit.csv")

results_activity_PP <- run_deseq(coldata, counts,
  "sed60num_quartile_postpartum", "High", c("Group", "Low", "High"),
  "results_activity_PP_DEGs_NAomit.csv")

# ---- MVPA ----
results_mvpa_T1 <- run_deseq(coldata, counts,
  "mvpa_quartile_trimester1", "Low", c("Group", "High", "Low"),

results_mvpa_T2 <- run_deseq(coldata, counts,

results_mvpa_PP <- run_deseq(coldata, counts,
```

# ============================================================
# FIGURE 7 — Volcano Plots: SED60+ T1, T2, T3
# Note: Panels A–C generated individually; combined and lettered in PowerPoint
# ============================================================
```{r fig7}
make_volcano <- function(results_obj, title, subtitle, n_total, output_file) {
  df <- as.data.frame(results_obj)

  p <- EnhancedVolcano(
    df,
    lab          = rownames(df),
    x            = "log2FoldChange",
    y            = "padj",
    title        = title,
    subtitle     = subtitle,
    titleLabSize    = 16,
    subtitleLabSize = 13,
    pCutoff      = 0.054,
    FCcutoff     = 1.0,
    pointSize    = 2.0,
    labSize      = 5.0,
    colAlpha     = 0.6,
    selectLab    = rownames(df)[!is.na(df$padj) & df$padj < 0.054],
    drawConnectors  = TRUE,
    widthConnectors = 0.5,
    max.overlaps    = 50,
    legendPosition  = "right",
    legendLabels    = c("NS", "Log2FC", "P-value", "P-value + Log2FC"),
    col          = c("grey60", "#0072B2", "#CC79A7", "#009E73"),
    xlim         = c(-6, 6),
    ylim         = c(0, 3.5),
    caption      = paste0("total = ", n_total, " variables")
  ) +
    theme(
      axis.text  = element_text(size = 11),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 13)
    )

  ggsave(output_file, plot = p,
         width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300, compression = "lzw")
  return(p)
}

# Count total variables per timepoint (non-NA padj)
n_T1 <- sum(!is.na(as.data.frame(results_activity_T1)$padj))
n_T2 <- sum(!is.na(as.data.frame(results_activity_T2)$padj))
n_T3 <- sum(!is.na(as.data.frame(results_activity_T3)$padj))

fig7A <- make_volcano(results_activity_T1,
  title    = "Trimester One Prolonged Sedentary Behavior",
  subtitle = "Average minutes/day in sedentary bouts >=60 min, Q1 vs. Q3",
  n_total  = n_T1,
  output_file = "Figure_7A.tiff")

fig7B <- make_volcano(results_activity_T2,
  title    = "Trimester Two Prolonged Sedentary Behavior",
  subtitle = "Average minutes/day in sedentary bouts >=60 min, Q1 vs. Q3",
  n_total  = n_T2,
  output_file = "Figure_7B.tiff")

fig7C <- make_volcano(results_activity_T3,
```
